We are pleased to provide an update on the fund's renewable-energy investment.

Cascade Renewables Fund III holds a majority stake in a renewable-energy generation platform.

The platform benefits from long-term contracted cash flows and meaningful geographic diversification.

The platform operates 1.2 GW of installed capacity.

The fund targets attractive risk-adjusted returns underpinned by contracted revenue.

Aldous Renewables is the fund's largest limited partner.
